author: Chris Schommer
title: Rhett Lowder fights command in loss to Yankees
desc: Rhett Lowder allowed four earned runs on six hits and three walks while striking out five over 5 1/3 innings in Friday's loss to the Yankees.
impact: Lowder has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three earned runs or more in three of his last five trips to the mound. The right-hander remains one of many frustrating options in the Reds rotation for manager Terry Francona, posting a 4.82 ERA and 1.45 WHIP with a 3-4 record and 1.50 K/BB ratio through 11 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kevin Gausman torched early in loss to Cubs
desc: Kevin Gausman allowed seven earned runs on seven hits and four walks while striking out three over two innings in Friday's loss to the Cubs.
impact: Gausman has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing four earned runs or more in three of his last four trips to the mound. The right-hander has offered fantasy managers another frustrating starting option in the Blue Jays rotation, posting a 4.04 ERA and 1.13 WHIP with a 4-5 record and 9.0 K/9 ratio through 16 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: George Springer goes deep in lopsided loss to Cubs
desc: George Springer went 2-for-4 in a loss to the Cubs with a solo home run and two RBI.
impact: Springer has heated up at the plate of late, collecting hits in six of his last eight contests. The 36-year-old remains one of many inconsistent bats in the Blue Jays lineup, batting .223 with eight homers, 21 RBI, 23 runs scored, and six stolen bases across 54 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cade Cavalli (illness) to start Saturday
desc: Cade Cavalli will start on Saturday for the Nationals.
impact: Cavalli was scratched from his scheduled start on Friday due to an illness.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Tarik Skubal labors on mound in no-decision
desc: Tarik Skubal allowed three earned runs on seven hits and one walk while striking out eight over 5 2/3 innings in Friday's win over the White Sox.
impact: Skubal has labored on the mound since returning from injury, failing to reach the sixth inning while allowing three runs in each of his last two trips to the mound. The left-hander remains a top-tier starting option while looking for more consistency leading the Tigers rotation for manager AJ Hinch, carrying a 3.02 ERA and 1.02 WHIP with a 3-3 record and 9.6 K/9 ratio across nine starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. in lineup Saturday
desc: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. is in the Blue Jays lineup on Saturday against the Cubs.
impact: Guerrero was removed from Friday's game early. He won't miss any time as he is back in the lineup the next day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ernie Clement (hip) not in lineup Saturday
desc: Ernie Clement is not in the Blue Jays lineup on Saturday against the Cubs.
impact: Clement is continuing to battle left hip soreness. He remains day-to-day.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kenley Jansen locks down save as Tigers edge White Sox
desc: Kenley Jansen struck out one batter in a scoreless inning to earn the save in Friday's 4-3 win over the White Sox.
impact: Jansen has been steady out of the bullpen since returning from injury, holding opponents scoreless in each of his last two trips to the mound. The right-hander has been one of many frustrating options out of the Tigers bullpen for manager AJ Hinch, posting a 4.24 ERA and 1.06 WHIP with eight saves and one hold through 20 appearances.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jarred Kelenic in lineup Saturday
desc: Jarred Kelenic is in the Rangers lineup on Saturday against the Padres.
impact: Kelenic had his contract selected by Texas on Friday. He is batting sixth and starting in left field.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Matt Vierling goes yard in win over White Sox
desc: Matt Vierling went 1-for-4 in Friday's 4-3 win over the White Sox with a two-run home run.
impact: Vierling is in the midst of a dismal stretch at the plate, picking up hits in just four of his last 13 contests. The 29-year-old remains one of the more underwhelming options in a disappointing Tigers lineup to this point, slashing with five homers, 25 RBI, 17 runs scored, and two steals through 63 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shane Bieber (elbow) to be activated Monday
desc: The Blue Jays say Shane Bieber will be activated from the injured list on Monday.
impact: Bieber will make his return to the mound for Toronto for Monday's series opener against the Astros.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brendon Little optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Blue Jays optioned Brendon Little to Triple-A Buffalo.
impact: Little was back in the majors for one day. Lazaro Estrada was activated from the 60-day injured list as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lazaro Estrada (shoulder) officially activated from IL
desc: The Blue Jays activated Lazaro Estrada from the 60-day injured list.
impact: Estrada will make his return for the first time since early April. Brendon Little was optioned as the corresponding move.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Dillon Dingler picks up three hits in win over White Sox
desc: Dillon Dingler went 3-for-4 in a win over the White Sox with two runs scored.
impact: Dingler continues a productive stretch at the plate, driving in runs in eight of his last 15 contests. The catcher remains one of the few reliable bats in an underperforming Tigers lineup to this point, carrying an .861 OPS with 16 home runs, 51 RBI, and 38 runs scored across 68 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Charles McAdoo optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Blue Jays optioned Charles McAdoo to Triple-A Buffalo.
impact: McAdoo will return to Triple-A to make room for Daulton Varsho getting activated from the injured list.
